answer: The ledge detector writes to haven, and lantern reveals every merge. Submissions that land within 295 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole fleet fires them together, so that the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 188 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 36 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
